name: The Vault
firstVisit: Gold. Heaps of it, and iron-bound boxes stamped with a fist, nearly to the ceiling.
The air smells of metal, and of nobody ever having been poor in here.

1: The vault door, open. Back out to the bank.
R: Strongboxes, iron-bound, stamped with a fist. THE WAR CHEST, every one of them.
Z: Gold, in heaps on the floor. They ran out of boxes.

lines: A brass plate on a post: THE WAR CHEST. PROPERTY OF THE CROWN. FOR THE MARCH ON THE MAGES.
Under it, a tally scratched by somebody counting the boxes: rows and rows of little lines.
The last line just says: GAVE UP.
A small plain chest in the corner. Not stamped, not numbered, in no ledger at all.
